description: Check whether a website is up right now: HTTP status, response time in ms, full redirect chain, and the SSL certificate's validity, issuer and days until expiry. Use when monitoring a site, diagnosing a broken link, or warning that a certificate is about to expire. A site that is down still returns 200 with up:false and the error. Errors: 400 bad or private URL. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).
name: website_status_check
title: Website up and SSL check
